basic_details.job_title: District Court Nandurbar Employee for Porta Cabins of e-Seva Kendras Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The District and Sessions Court, Nandurbar (Jilha va Satra Nyayalay, Nandurbar) is preparing a selection list of 04 candidates for the post of Contractual Employee for Porta Cabins of e-Seva Kendras (E-Seva Kendranchya Porta Cabinssathi Kantrati Karmachari). The posts are under the third phase of the e-Court Project and are for 11 months or until the grant is available, whichever is earlier. Applications in the Annexure A format must reach the Registrar, District and Sessions Court, Tokar Talav Road, Nandurbar by post or by hand on or before 20 November 2026, 05:00 PM.

important_instructions: The appointment is contractual and temporary, limited to the next 11 months or until the grant is available, whichever is earlier; no claim can be made on the appointment. The appointment will be made considering the candidate's work and the directions received from the Hon'ble High Court from time to time. The Principal District and Sessions Judge, Nandurbar has the right to terminate the service at any time. Any pressure or request about the place of posting will lead to cancellation of the selection. Nandurbar, Shahada, Taloda and Akkalkuwa courts

content_sections.heading: About Nandurbar District Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The District and Sessions Court, Nandurbar is the district court of Nandurbar in Maharashtra. Under the third phase of the e-Court Project, porta cabins have been provided for e-Seva Kendras at District Court Nandurbar and the courts under it: District Court-1 Shahada, Civil Court Junior Division Taloda and Civil Court Junior Division Akkalkuwa. The contractual employees are being selected to staff these e-Seva Kendra porta cabins.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only offline, by post or by hand during office hours, at this address: Registrar, District and Sessions Court, Tokar Talav Road, Nandurbar, Taluka and District Nandurbar, PIN Code - 425412. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered under any circumstances, and postal delay will not be considered. Applications will not be accepted on office holidays.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The pay is an honorarium / salary of Rs.15,000/- per month. No other allowances will be given in addition to this pay. Para Legal Volunteers (PLV) will be considered on priority. A certificate of Marathi and English typing knowledge, if held, can be enclosed with the application. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post. The candidate must be willing to work as per items 4 and 5 of the guidelines issued by the e-Committee of the Hon'ble Supreme Court dated 25/04/2020 for implementation of the e-Seva Kendra project. The notice says a copy of items 4 and 5 is attached to it. The bond attached to the form states that the appointee may be given responsibility for important work of the District Court and will be trained in the court's procedures and policies.

rows.post: Contractual Employee for Porta Cabins of e-Seva Kendras

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested copies (attested by an officer or person authorised to attest) of these documents must be submitted with the application: Submitting these documents is mandatory if the court administration asks for them. No original document or certificate should be attached to the application.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by scrutiny of applications, a shortlist where needed, a practical test if necessary, and an interview. Applications received in time will be scrutinised. If the number of eligible applications is large, the Computer Committee, District Court, Nandurbar will prepare a shortlist on the basis of merit, applying suitable criteria. All rights to prepare the shortlist and run the selection rest with this committee. The list of candidates eligible for interview will be published on 23 November 2026 on the district court website. The interview date and time will be given in that list and will not be communicated separately. A practical test will be held if found necessary. Selection will be on merit, based on the marks in the practical test (if held) and the interview. The list of selected candidates will be published on the notice board of District Court, Nandurbar and on the website. Candidates called for interview must bring the originals of the documents submitted with the application for verification, and the original of the photo ID attached (Voter card, PAN card, Aadhaar card or Driving licence) to the practical test and interview. Candidates attend at their own cost; no expenses will be paid by the office.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Nandurbar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The District and Sessions Court, Nandurbar is preparing a selection list of 04 candidates for the post of Contractual Employee for Porta Cabins of e-Seva Kendras.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Registrar, District and Sessions Court, Nandurbar on or before 20 November 2026, 05:00 PM; late applications and postal delays will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: A graduate in any discipline with knowledge of using and handling computers and related equipment, and a certificate of passing the related examination, can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age must be minimum 18 years and maximum 35 years as on the date of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the e-Seva Kendra contractual employee?
faq.answer: The post carries an honorarium / salary of Rs.15,000/- per month, and no other allowances will be given in addition to it.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure A form, attach attested copies of the listed documents, write "Application for the post of Contractual Employee for Porta Cabins of e-Seva Kendras" on the envelope, and send it by post or by hand to District and Sessions Court, Tokar Talav Road, Nandurbar, PIN 425412.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinised and shortlisted by the Computer Committee if needed, followed by a practical test (if necessary) and an interview; selection is on merit based on the marks obtained.

faq.question: Q8. When will the interview list be published?
faq.answer: The list of candidates eligible for interview will be published on 23 November 2026 on the district court website, with the interview date and time.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is contractual and temporary for the next 11 months or until the grant is available, whichever is earlier, and the service can be terminated at any time.

faq.question: Q10. Do Para Legal Volunteers get preference?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who are Para Legal Volunteers (PLV) will be considered on priority.
